text:
maya: Opening a small PR to tidy the Quickstart + Onboarding tutorial. Two goals: 1) make the auth section platform-agnostic (placeholder endpoint + REDWOOD_API_KEY) and call out Dedicated endpoint differences, 2) add a tiny Go example for minimal request + a docker 'first deploy' sanity check. PR: http://git.internal/r/redwood/docs/pull/4180. Asking for eng-runtime + devex reviews.

docs-bot: PR #4180 opened by maya — docs-ci checks queued.

lin: Love this. Can we add a one-sentence mapping for regions/hosts for Dedicated customers? Several partners asked where to point the endpoint (i.e. <customer>.redwoodprivate.example). Keep it short.

jon: I'll pick up the Go snippet and make sure import paths match the new SDK naming. Note: we renamed the module to "github.com/redwoodai/inference-go" last quarter.

alice: Also we need a brief note about token rotation: advise against long-lived plain text tokens in repos and point to the KMS + secret-injection playbook. A single sentence will do.

maya: Agreed. Drafting text now. Also saw a flaky Dockerfile step (node base image) in the starter app; I'll add a short note suggesting multi-stage build + pin to node:18-lts for now.

sam: If you want, I can open a follow-up tiny PR to the starter repo to switch the Dockerfile to multi-stage + node:18 so users don't hit native build errors.

jon: Quick heads-up: when you add the Go snippet, please show one minimal sync request and a short production hint (context: use batches / retry with backoff). I'll make the module import correction in a review comment.

maya: Pushed initial commit with placeholders and this minimal curl + Go example under "Auth & First Request":

```bash
# minimal curl example
export REDWOOD_API_KEY="<token>"
export REDWOOD_ENDPOINT="https://<REDWOOD_ENDPOINT>"

curl -sS "$REDWOOD_ENDPOINT/v1/generate" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-4-mini","input":"hello from quickstart"}'
```

```go
// minimal Go example using github.com/redwoodai/inference-go
package main

import (
  "context"
  "fmt"
  "os"
  rwd "github.com/redwoodai/inference-go"
)

func main() {
  client := rwd.NewClient(os.Getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY"), os.Getenv("REDWOOD_ENDPOINT"))
  resp, err := client.Generate(context.Background(), rwd.Request{Model: "gpt-4-mini", Input: "hello"})
  if err != nil {
    fmt.Println("err:", err)
    return
  }
  fmt.Println("out:", resp.Output)
}
```
